workarounds.note: the H1 breakBefore { parity: 'even' } is restated because a headings object drops it (gotcha headings-drop-h1-break)

col() writes the hex beside each paletteId, because 1.4.1 paints design elements (openers, cover, folios) and bodyText.referenceColor from the hex, never from the palette (gotcha palette-skips-designs)

the title and the tombstone give lineHeight as a multiple (pt leading / size for the tombstone), because a Dimension silently drops the opener's reserved height, minHeight included (gotcha design-lineheight-multiple)
bodyText.maxRuntTracking is 0: a runt fix's negative tracking is measured but never painted (gotcha runt-tracking-unpainted)
the three-line tombstone is one attribute with \n breaks, which a design text honours only with a paragraphIndent, so it carries paragraphIndent: pt(0.01) (gotcha design-text-newline)
every frontmatter value is quoted (the title feeds the verso folio line)
the cover's tracked name (DORÉ) is moved right by half its tracking: 1.4.1 measures design text with the tracking after its last letter, so centred tracked capitals stand left of the centre line
